records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Partners
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Partners' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I haven't heard back since we set up a welcome call, so I wanted to check in rather than leave you to it. No rush on my account 
s

If it helps, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project 
s projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. Once something real is in there, inviting your team is the natural next step.
